a: IIT Madras - BS in Electronic Systems
d:
This video is part of the UG degree programs IIT Madras, Chennai, India offers. Applications open.
IIT Madras offers 4 flexible, Non-Campus 4-year BS Degrees.
BS in Data Science and Applications (launched in January 2021, 45000 students, more than 5000 have completed a diploma or degree)
BS in Electronics Systems (launched in Sep 2023, 2000 students)
BS in Management and Data Science (launched in June 2026)
BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology (launched in June 2026)
• No limit on seats
• JEE not required
